deliverables: custodial wallet onboarding inside Sellout flow
public launch campaign and trade-show activations
public metrics dashboard and governance reporting
request.recipient: Anvil Development Agency, Inc. / Intersect as budget administrator through the TRSC/PSSC framework
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for Phase 2 of a production Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency.

claims.claim: Phase 1 of the ticketing platform is already live on Cardano mainnet and includes on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification.
Sellout has invested over $130,000 of its own capital into Phase 1.
The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, stated as approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, over 8 months with milestone-gated disbursements.
Phase 2 targets 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ CIP-68 NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6 million or more in ticket revenue on-chain, and 20,000+ new wallets within 12 months from launch.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 concert series is presented as a contracted anchor deployment projected to move over $6 million through Cardano in year one.
The team commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism using 25% of fees until full reimbursement and 5% thereafter.

The proposal provides a detailed capital allocation table totaling 4,969,231 ada, including labor, development, marketing, audit, infrastructure, contingency, legal formation, and a 3% Intersect administration fee.
All on-chain success metrics are stated to be independently verifiable through Cardano explorer data, policy-ID tracking, a public dashboard, and quarterly Cardano Forum reports.
Anvil/Sellout state that they have not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.
The proposer states the withdrawal does not exceed the applicable 350M Net Change Limit at the moment of submission.

summary: The document describes a large, milestone-gated treasury withdrawal for an enterprise ticketing platform with claimed existing mainnet work, adoption targets, a revenue-share repayment commitment, and detailed budget/milestone structure, but many central adoption, deployment, and track-record claims are asserted rather than evidenced inside the anchor text.
